_audit_meta.labeler: claude-opus-4-7 (agent-labeled first pass; user to review)
_audit_meta.method: Walked all 25 capturing-branch records from .intake-log.jsonl on the dogfooded loom store. Labels: y=real capture (durable rule/finding/methodology), n=noise (one-time instruction, scenario fragment, env fact, tool docs, speculation), ?=borderline (was real at the time but archived since, or genuinely ambiguous). Notes explain reasoning per record.
